title: RADIO FREQUENCY IDENTIFICATION (RFID) ELECTRONIC LOCKING SYSTEMS FOR UNACCOMPANIED  HOUSING AT NAS PENSACOLA, FL
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVFAC > NAVFAC ATLANTIC CMD > NAVFAC SOUTHEAST > NAVFACSYSCOM SOUTHEAST
description:
THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT, A MARKET SURVEY FOR WRITTEN INFORMATION ONLY, TO IDENTIFY POTENTIAL COMMERCIAL AVAILABILITY OF RADIO FREQUENCY IDENTIFICATION (RFID) ELECTRONIC LOCKING SYSTEMS THAT MEET THE SALIENT CHARACTERISTICS OUTLINED BELOW AND THE FACILITIES CRITERIA FOR NAVY AND MARINE CORPS UNACCOMPANIED HOUSING (UH), FC 4-721-10N, AND TO DETERMINE WHETHER ANY SYSTEM OTHER THAN THE DORMAKABA 790 RFID ELECTRONIC LOCKING SYSTEM CAN MEET ALL FUNCTIONAL, OPERATIONAL, STANDALONE, AND CYBERSECURITY-RELATED REQUIREMENTS IDENTIFIED IN THIS ANNOUNCEMENT.  

  

  THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS OR AN INVITATION FOR BID.  NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS ANNOUNCEMENT.  NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION REQUESTS. No telephone calls will be accepted requesting a bid package or solicitation.  There is no bid package or solicitation currently available.  In order to protect the procurement integrity of any future procurement that may arise from this announcement, information regarding the technical point of contact will not be given and no appointments for presentations will be made.   

  

  The reference number for this posting is N6945027RP801-RFID.  This is a market research tool being used to determine the availability and adequacy of potential sources that can furnish RFID electronic locking systems that meet the salient characteristics outlined below. 

  

  Project Description:  

  

 P801 is a Design-Bid-Build construction project located at Naval Air Station Pensacola, FL. 

 The project includes construction of a 156,956 square feet, three-story dormitory containing 280 dorm rooms and housing 560 students.  The facility will include quarterdeck, administrative offices, multi-purpose and laundry rooms and building support spaces. 

 RFID e-Locks salient characteristics: 

 
	 Accredited by U.S. Fleet Cyber Command (eMASS ID #12354) for use for this application 
	 Be compatible with applicable Navy and Marine Corps Unaccompanied Housing requirements and FC 4-721-10N 
	 Be an all-in-one, standalone system that does not require an external computer interface, external network connection, or Navy network connectivity for normal operation 
	 Include locks with battery compartments accessible from the exterior of the lock 
	 Include stand-alone Front Desk Unit with no external network connectivity 
	 Operate using embedded proprietary firmware and have no networking capability 
	 Not require a Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) stack or other network protocols for normal operation 
	 Not permit installation of third-party applications, including antivirus software, on the FDU or associated standalone system components 
	 Not require Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) scans, Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) implementation, or vulnerability scanning for normal operation 
	 Be capable of local administration through the standalone FDU without requiring an external computer or network connection 
	 The system does not contain or process any PII or other sensitive data.  System only stores a 5 digit room number and key card expiration date 
 

 The spaces to have e-Locks include: 

 
	 Dorm rooms 
	 Closets 
	 Multi-Purpose rooms 
	 Laundry rooms
